title: Updates are due
what: The last update was about {detail} days ago.
why: Regular updates keep the computer secure and working.
fix_summary: Install all updates. Needs the internet.
backup_first: A snapshot is taken first if available.
undo: Roll back from the snapshot list.

title: Old downloads can be cleared
what: Downloaded software files use about {detail} MB.
why: Clearing them frees space and does no harm.

title: The system logs can be trimmed
why: Keeping them to a sensible size saves space.
fix_summary: Trim the logs to 200 MB. Recent entries stay.
undo: Old entries cannot be brought back.

title: The SSD tidy-up has never run
what: The weekly tidy-up for the SSD is on but has not run yet.
why: A tidy-up keeps the SSD fast.

title: The disk check for hidden damage is due
what: The last read-through check of the disk was {detail} days ago.
fix_summary: Start a read-through check. It runs quietly in the background.

title: Old snapshots can be tidied
what: There are {detail} snapshots of the system.
why: Keeping only the recent ones saves space.
fix_summary: Remove old snapshots by the usual rules.
undo: Old snapshots cannot be brought back.
manual: Run: sudo snapper -c root cleanup number

title: Firmware updates are due
why: Firmware updates fix bugs and security problems.
fix_summary: Install firmware updates; the charger must be plugged in.

title: The clock needs setting from the internet
why: A correct clock matters for secure websites.

title: Unused packages can be removed
what: About {detail} packages are no longer needed.
fix_summary: Remove unused packages. It shows the list first.
undo: Install them again from the software sources.

title: Old system versions can be removed
what: {detail} versions of the system core are installed.
why: Keeping the newest two is enough.
fix_summary: Remove the oldest versions; keep the newest two.
backup_first: A list of what is removed.
undo: Install them again from the software sources.
manual: Remove old system cores with your package manager.
